Proposition
[Symmetric derivative of an extension] 1. 11.1.5\group derivatives Source: thurston:page-0311, thurston:page-0312

For $Y\in T_xH^3$ and a $C^1$ boundary vector field $X$, \[ \nabla ^s_Y\operatorname {ex}X =\frac{3}{4\pi }\int _{S^2_\infty }i_*\bigl(\bar\partial X(Y_\infty )\bigr)\, dV_x. \]
Proof

\sketch Both sides are symmetric in the tested tangent direction. Apply the derivative formula to $Y$ and use that the extension of $iY_\infty $ vanishes at $x$; the resulting two integral identities combine into the displayed integral by the definition of $\bar\partial $.

□
